about: Probe 9a: use_figma responses, Figma file KoShLIaIOXj6vWAuwLTff8, page "storysync probe 9a", 2026-10-14. Call 1 is spikes/figma-probe-9a-1.js, call 2 spikes/figma-probe-9a-2.js, each response as use_figma returned it. Call 1: shared plugin data of 45,000 characters on a page and 24,000 on the document is kept, and the latter runs through the AsyncFunction constructor; 101,000 on a page is kept too. Hugging texts (WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT) are set to whole pixels, 39.05/84.4/80.85 wide at line height 19.25 as 40/85/81 by 20, so a hugging row of them is 218 for the browser's 216.3; the same texts fixed (NONE) at those sizes keep them, and their row is 216.3, each at its browser x. A fixed-width text growing to its lines (HEIGHT) rounds its height up: one line of 19.25 is 20, five are 97. A frame keeps 272.29 by 19.25. Geist Medium 14 sets 'Select a fruit' 85 wide hugging, and in a box 84.5 wide wraps to two lines (48): wider than the browser's 84.5. Call 2: what call 1 stored is there in a later call, runs as code, and goes when set to ''. combineAsVariants of a plain component keeps its node id as the set's variant, the set where the component was, and its instance on it, now with the variant property; renaming a set's variants onto a new axis one at a time leaves Figma flagging the set midway ('Component set has existing errors' on componentPropertyDefinitions) until the last is renamed, after which the instance is still on its variant, now disabled=false; removing the added variant and renaming the rest back drops the axis, the instance still on its variant.
